verdict.rationale: Railway's docs show managed deployment of full-stack apps without hand-run servers. You connect a repo and Railway handles the rest with auto-config, SSL, load balancing and protocol handling, plus replica scaling, regional placement closer to users, one-click starters and CLI deploys. Nothing in the evidence describes a serverless-functions product (e.g. function-level deploys or scale-to-zero), so only the full-stack half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented serverless/function deployment, independent hands-on corroboration of the no-ops deployment experience.
